description: This file implements the internal server-side logic for managing media key sessions, including creation, deletion, decryption, and session state management within the Rialto media server component.

classes.name: MediaKeysServerInternal
classes.description: Implements internal management of media key sessions, including creation, decryption, session state management, and interaction with the main thread and underlying DRM system.

methods.name: generateSessionId
methods.description: Generates a new unique session ID for media key sessions.

methods.name: MediaKeysServerInternal
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the media keys server internal object, setting up the main thread, DRM system, and session factory.

methods.name: ~MediaKeysServerInternal
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up resources and unregisters the main thread client.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a key ID for a given session.

methods.name: selectKeyIdInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for selecting a key ID for a session.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a session contains a specific key.

methods.name: containsKeyInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for checking key presence in a session.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session with specified parameters.

methods.name: createKeySessionInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for creating a new key session.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request for a session.

methods.name: generateRequestInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for generating a license request.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: loadSessionInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for loading a session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with response data.

methods.name: updateSessionInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for updating a session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets DRM header data for a session.

methods.name: setDrmHeaderInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for setting DRM header.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Closes a key session.

methods.name: closeKeySessionInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for closing a session.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Removes a key session.

methods.name: removeKeySessionInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for removing a session.

methods.name: deleteDrmStore
methods.description: Deletes the DRM secure store.

methods.name: deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit for LDL sessions.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error for a session.

methods.name: getLastDrmErrorInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for retrieving the last DRM error.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current DRM time.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID for a session.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionIdInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for retrieving the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted buffer for a session.

methods.name: decryptInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for decrypting buffers.

methods.name: hasSession
methods.description: Checks if a session exists.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a session uses the PlayReady key system.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystemInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for checking PlayReady key system.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Increments the usage counter for a session.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounterInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for incrementing session usage.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Decrements the usage counter for a session.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounterInternal
methods.description: Internal implementation for decrementing session usage and possibly closing the session.
